telegram._help: Create bot via @BotFather, add as admin to the channel (yours is @t27_lang); chat_id like @t27_lang or -100...

devto._help: Settings > Extensions > DEV Community API Keys

hashnode._help: Hashnode > Blogs > Settings > Developer (Personal Access Token). Drafts land in your blog's drafts.

medium._help: Settings > Integration tokens (integration tokens are limited to draft posts)

indexnow._help: Instant re-index ping (Bing, Yandex...). Key = name of the <key>.txt file at the site root.
